node.title: F WLOG reduction: factor out the plane's common divisor
node.statement: Let w = deg gcd(P cap D_j). Division by the gcd maps P cap D_j injectively into P' cap D'_{j-w} for an explicit linear P' of dim <= dim P over the co-domain (X^n-1)/gcd, with trivial image gcd. Hence F reduces to gcd-trivial planes; the deep-gcd branch IS the tangent shape.
